claim_scores.rationale: The program sets `model='openai/inference-model'` and `finetuning_model='openai/base-train-model'`, then asserts the provider saw `'openai/base-train-model'`.
It resolves the job, gets a `dspy.LM`, and asserts `trained_lm.model == 'openai/ft:trained-model'`, not the original inference model.
The custom provider explicitly sets `self.finetunable = True`, satisfying the fine-tuning precondition.
`train_kwargs={'epochs': 1}` is supplied at `LM` construction, omitted from `lm.finetune(...)`, and the provider captures the forwarded `train_kwargs`.
The provider captures forwarded training metadata via its `finetune(...)` parameters and stores `train_data_format`; the example also passes training data into `lm.finetune(...)`.
